script:
import wave, numpy as np, json, sys
src='audio/sfx/absorb-channel-1.wav'
w=wave.open(src); sr=w.getframerate(); ch=w.getnchannels()
a=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype=np.int16).reshape(-1,ch).astype(float)/32768
dur=0.85; n=int(sr*dur); t=np.arange(n)/sr
# Playback rate: a quick rise to 2.2x by 0.18 s, then a slower fall to 0.85x.
up, top, low = 0.18, 2.2, 0.85
rate=np.where(t<up, 1+(top-1)*np.sin(0.5*np.pi*t/up), low+(top-low)*np.cos(0.5*np.pi*np.clip((t-up)/(dur-up),0,1))**2)
pos=np.cumsum(rate)+int(0.5*sr)
out=np.stack([np.interp(pos,np.arange(len(a)),a[:,c]) for c in range(ch)],1)
env=np.minimum(1,t/0.03)*np.where(t<up,1,np.cos(0.5*np.pi*np.clip((t-up)/(dur-up),0,1))**1.5)
out*=env[:,None]
out=out/abs(out).max()*0.8
wo=wave.open('audio/sfx/absorb-take-5.wav','wb'); wo.setnchannels(ch); wo.setsampwidth(2); wo.setframerate(sr)
wo.writeframes((out*32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes()); wo.close()
json.dump({"made_from": src, "how": "absorb-channel-1 from 0.5 s played at a bent rate: 1x up to 2.2x over 0.18 s, then down to 0.85x by 0.85 s, swelling in over 30 ms and fading after the peak", "script": "inline numpy resample, see the absorb-take row in audio/sfx.md"}, open('audio/sfx/absorb-take-5.prompt.json','w'), indent=2)
print('ok', n/sr)
